messages.subject: Instats Launches All-Access Subscriptions
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats has just launched a new subscription option, which provides unlimited access to our extensive on-demand streaming library, with thousands of hours of research training content by preeminent experts across a wide variety of fields, methods, and software packages. In addition, subscribers receive an automatic 30% discount on all livestreaming seminars.  Purchase as many subscriptions as you need. Instats offers a 10% discount on 5 or more subscriptions. 

Click here for more information and please get in touch if you'd like to subscribe your PhD students or faculty members as a group -- we're always happy to help!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
